printed_to_pdf_page_rule: PDF page floor((printed page + 6) / 2); even printed page left, odd right.
row_scope: All explicit nonstop rows in 26 selected direction headings; through/connecting rows excluded from transcription and import. No independently timed ACT–CLL 1929 row found in the selected local heading.
operator_identification: Printed p.4: flights 1875–1999 operated by Rio Airways; triangle denotes Delta Connection. Adjacent 1750–1874 range belongs to Ransome and is not assigned to Rio.
frequency_legend: D encodes blank/daily; X excludes listed weekdays, 1 Monday through 7 Sunday. Star denotes off-peak fare, not a date rollover.

special_cases.DFW–LAW: 1908 and 1932 are through rows, not nonstop. Nonstop 1918 is 15:40–16:25 daily; 1933 is 18:30–19:15 Saturdays only.
special_cases.DFW–ILE: 1934 is Sunday only and produces no movement in this Thursday–Saturday window.
special_cases.Saturday_only: DFW–LAW 1933, LAW–SPS 1933 and DFW–SJT 1922 are after the Saturday window end; retained as reviewed schedules with zero movements.
special_cases.ACT–CLL 1929: No independently timed local row in printed p.243; DFW–CLL through arrival does not justify inventing its intermediate departure.
special_cases.aircraft: BE1 is listed for Rio in the legend; no flight-specific aircraft or registration assigned from that generic legend.
special_cases.airport_locations: Nine new historical-airfield markers; modern estimated reference coordinates approximate the same airfields, not 1986 aircraft positions.
